caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic or porcelain figurine of two birds standing side by side on a rectangular base. The birds have white bodies and are adorned with decorative markings: their wings and tails are painted in shades of red, yellow, green, and brown, with a layered, textured pattern. Both birds have red crests on their heads and round, dark eyes. One bird appears to have a black marking near its beak. The rectangular base is colored in reddish-brown tones with a slightly raised border, supporting both birds. The background is plain, and the artwork is framed by a simple, thin-lined rectangular border on a cream or off-white piece of paper. The artist's name, "MINA LOWRY," is written in small, uppercase letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Chalkware Roosters
